svg.title: Wolfee-Watcher — kvisior-edge, external kvisior HUB and PostgreSQL
svg.desc: kvisior-edge is a separate component inside the Kubernetes cluster. kube-apiserver sends admission requests to sentry-audit and writes the audit log that sentry-audit reads on control-plane nodes. The external kvisior HUB and PostgreSQL are outside the cluster. The operator connects to the HUB, which reads history from PostgreSQL and forwards live requests to Edge. Agents send data to Edge over mTLS.
svg.text: History in the shared database. Live requests through kvisior-edge.

g.text: Helm · namespace wolfee-watcher · local agent data
Shared history · data scoped by cluster_id
External database schema and service roles

svg.text: Agents → kvisior-edge: mTLS · HUB → Edge: HTTPS + federation token · PostgreSQL: SQL / TLS
cert-server issues certificates to local Go services. The external kvisior HUB does not collect local telemetry.
kube-apiserver → sentry-audit: admission webhook (failurePolicy Ignore) and audit.log, read by its DaemonSet on control-plane nodes · sentry-audit → kvisior-edge: PVC spool, push with ACK.
